Trinity S³AI

Times one trit: copy, drop or flip

Multiplying by a trit needs no multiplier. By +1 the number is copied, by 0 dropped, by -1 every trit is flipped.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/ternary/trits.t27 (t27#8979): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js), with 18 tests and 4108 runtime asserts
  • S. Ma and others, The Era of 1-bit LLMs: All Large Language Models are in 1.58 Bits, 2024: weights of -1, 0 and +1
